prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one 4:3 landscape painting for The Burnt Book Sanskrit learning story. Request 1536 x 1152 native output or the closest supported native 4:3 resolution. Refined Indian watercolor with restrained gouache on warm ivory paper; organic detail, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta, muted indigo. Warm, gentle, evocative storytelling, consistent character design.
Canonical scene brief: A quiet courtyard school in Pāṭaliputra: a thin earnest young man in plain white with a shaved head and a bundle of palm leaves sitting a little apart from the other pupils, slow and sorrowful; the teacher Varṣa's wife at a doorway making a gentle but firm gesture of dismissal; warm old-India watercolour.
Character appearances:
panini: A thin, earnest young man in a plain white dhoti, shaved head with a short tuft, pale from fasting, a bundle of palm leaves under his arm and a stubborn set to his jaw.
varsha: A thin man in a threadbare white dhoti, deep-set calm eyes and a patient smile, sitting on swept ground before a mud-walled house.
Phone-first composition: clear compact narrative grouping, essential faces, hands and objects comfortably inside all edges. Show the complete scene without border. No collage or multi-panel layout.
Writing is permitted by the owner. This particular scene needs no readable inscription; focus on its narrative. Do not invent scripts or fill small objects with pseudo-lettering. No watermark or UI.

sources.title: Kathāsaritsāgara, taraṅga 4 (Digital Corpus of Sanskrit file KSS, 1, 4), the story retold in new, simple sentences with three real half-verses quoted
sources.note: The plot follows Somadeva's text, told by Vararuci: in Varṣa's school there was a dull pupil, Pāṇini; he went to the Himālaya, pleased Śiva with austerity and received a new grammar, the mouth of all knowledge; he came back and defeated Vararuci in debate. The three quoted lines are Somadeva's own words; the rest is new Sanskrit in the present tense.

image.brief: A quiet courtyard school in Pāṭaliputra: a thin earnest young man in plain white with a shaved head and a bundle of palm leaves sitting a little apart from the other pupils, slow and sorrowful; the teacher Varṣa's wife at a doorway making a gentle but firm gesture of dismissal; warm old-India watercolour.

alt.en: A thin young man sits apart from other pupils while the teacher's wife gestures him away
alt.hi: दूसरे शिष्यों से अलग बैठा पतला युवक, उसे विदा करती गुरुपत्नी

meaning.en: With time Varṣa's pupils become many.
meaning.hi: समय के साथ वर्ष के शिष्य बहुत हो जाते हैं।

passage.sa: तत्र पाणिनिः नाम एकः शिष्यः अस्ति।

meaning.en: There is one pupil named Pāṇini.
meaning.hi: वहाँ पाणिनि नाम का एक शिष्य है।

meaning.en: “There was one, named Pāṇini, very dull of mind.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.4)
meaning.hi: “वहाँ पाणिनि नाम का एक था, अत्यन्त जड़-बुद्धि।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.4)

meaning.en: Pāṇini is dull.
meaning.hi: पाणिनि मन्द है।

meaning.en: He serves the teacher's wife.
meaning.hi: वह गुरुपत्नी की सेवा करता है।

meaning.en: The teacher's wife sends him away.
meaning.hi: गुरुपत्नी उसे भेज देती है।

meaning.en: He becomes weary.
meaning.hi: वह थक-हार जाता है।

meaning.en: He goes to the Himālaya.
meaning.hi: वह हिमालय जाता है।

image.brief: A high Himālayan slope with snow peaks and dark pines: the thin young man seated cross-legged on a flat rock beside a tiny fire, eyes closed in austerity, snow on his shoulders; above him on the peak a serene ascetic figure with a thin crescent moon in his matted hair, hand raised in blessing; drifting cloud; soft gold light.

alt.en: A thin young man sits in austerity on a snowy slope while a serene ascetic with a crescent moon blesses him
alt.hi: बर्फ़ीली ढलान पर तप करता पतला युवक, अर्धचन्द्र वाले शान्त तपस्वी का आशीर्वाद

meaning.en: There he practises austerity.
meaning.hi: वहाँ वह तप करता है।

meaning.en: He wants knowledge.
meaning.hi: वह विद्या चाहता है।

meaning.en: Śiva is pleased.
meaning.hi: शिव प्रसन्न होते हैं।

meaning.en: Śiva gives Pāṇini a new grammar.
meaning.hi: शिव पाणिनि को नया व्याकरण देते हैं।

meaning.en: “By him was obtained a new grammar, the mouth of all knowledge.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.4)
meaning.hi: “उसने एक नया व्याकरण पाया, सब विद्याओं का मुख।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.4)

meaning.en: Grammar is the mouth of all knowledge.
meaning.hi: व्याकरण सब विद्याओं का मुख है।

meaning.en: Pāṇini challenges Vararuci.
meaning.hi: पाणिनि वररुचि को ललकारता है।

image.brief: A courtyard in Pāṭaliputra at dusk: two scholars facing each other, one older and assured, one thin and pale; a ring of silent listeners; above, a dark sky with a great shape of cloud and the faint outline of an ascetic with a crescent moon raising a hand; an unrolled palm-leaf manuscript on the ground between the two debaters.

alt.en: Two scholars debate in a courtyard as a great shape appears in the dusk sky
alt.hi: आँगन में शास्त्रार्थ करते दो विद्वान्, साँझ के आकाश में एक विराट आकृति

meaning.en: The two hold a debate.
meaning.hi: दोनों शास्त्रार्थ करते हैं।

meaning.en: For seven days the two speak.
meaning.hi: सात दिन दोनों बोलते हैं।

passage.sa: अष्टमे दिने शिवः आकाशे हुङ्कारम् करोति।

meaning.en: On the eighth day Śiva roars in the sky.
meaning.hi: आठवें दिन शिव आकाश में गर्जन करते हैं।

meaning.en: “A great terrible roar was made by Śambhu from the sky.” (Somadeva, Kathāsaritsāgara 1.4)
meaning.hi: “आकाश में स्थित शम्भु ने महाभयंकर हुंकार किया।” (सोमदेव, कथासरित्सागर 1.4)

meaning.en: Indra's grammar is lost.
meaning.hi: इन्द्र का व्याकरण नष्ट हो जाता है।

meaning.en: Pāṇini wins.
meaning.hi: पाणिनि जीतता है।

meaning.en: Pāṇini's grammar stands in the world.
meaning.hi: पाणिनि का व्याकरण संसार में टिकता है।
